Title: Emit MCP progress notifications from agent_task at each iteration
Description: agent_task should emit notifications/progress at each iteration boundary: { progressToken: '...', progress: currentIter, total: maxIters, message: 'Iteration 2/4: Reviewing...' }. The MCP spec defines this natively. Gives callers a live iteration counter without polling get_task_status. Pairs with the streaming transport (already Streamable HTTP). Fix Meta null (TSK-0003) first since that affects the same tool.
